title: Progression Utils
description: A mod adding various end game ores, armors, weapons, and lots of new loot items
body:
![Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ProgressionUtils/BH_PU_HEADER.webp)
![OVERVIEW](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ProgressionUtils/BH_PU_Banner1.webp)
- All items feature a custom tooltip to specify what they're used for

- Custom recipes to allow almost all items to always serve a purpose

- New mob drops, and even player based drops

- Custom villager trades

- Overhauled RPG-Like loot added to most overworld/nether loot chests

- New Ores
